evidence: Frozen tests/test.sh, tests/Dockerfile and environment/Dockerfile are byte-identical to the template (diff clean), so the launch assumptions are the template's; each is stated to the agent. (1) Entry: test.sh:68 refuses without /app/server.js and test.sh:111 runs `node "$APP_ENTRY"`; instruction.md:13 'It must start with node /app/server.js'; integration.md:5. (2) Port/probe: test.sh:108 PORT=3000 and probe_ready test.sh:48 hits http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then /; instruction.md:13 'listen on port 3000 (honour PORT if it's set), expose GET /api/health as a check that never touches the database'; integration.md:5-6 'listens on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0' (covers the 127.0.0.1 probe; a localhost/::1-only bind would be the agent's own deviation) and integration.md:9-10 'GET /api/health answers before database work can block startup' (covers the ~30 s readiness loop, test.sh:116-125). (3) DB: test.sh:98/101/109 DB_PATH=/app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db; instruction.md:13 'keep its durable data in /app/app.db, honouring DB_PATH when that is set'; integration.md:7-8; hireops_rules.md:201. Restart helper reuses identical env (test.sh:160-167); instruction.md:15 'keep new work across restarts'. (4) Sanitized env: test.sh:104-109 env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT, DB_PATH; hireops_rules.md:202 'The launch environment contains PATH, HOME, NODE_PATH, PORT and DB_PATH; do not rely on inherited shell variables.' (5) Unprivileged user, writable copy, cwd: test.sh:99-102,110 setpriv uid 65534, fallback APP_ENTRY=/tmp/submission/server.js, cwd inherited from verifier (/tests); hireops_rules.md:198-201 'may launch Node from a working directory other than the application directory. It runs as an unprivileged user and may launch a writable copy ... Resolve bundled UI and seed files relative to the entry or module directory'. (6) Seed: test.sh does not pass a seed path; instruction.md:13,15 'using the seed data at /assets/seed_data.json' and 'Copy what you need into /app; /assets and /instructions are unavailable at runtime ... start with no shipped database' - the agent is told the stricter condition, so test.sh's chmod of /assets (line 88) is not a hidden dependency. (7) Deps: test.sh:106 NODE_PATH=/usr/local/lib/node_modules; tests/Dockerfile:16-21 installs express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1 matching environment/Dockerfile:9-11; instruction.md:13 'Server dependencies are already available, so don't install packages'; integration.md:3-4 'Express and better-sqlite3 already available through NODE_PATH; use only those packages and Node built-ins'. (8) Symlinks: test.sh:72-83 grade-zero on any symlink outside /app/node_modules or escaping it; integration.md:16-19 states exactly this rule (task-added paragraph absent from the template note, closing the template's gap). (9) Single process serving UI+API: instruction.md:13; prompts open http://localhost:3000 consistent with app_context.md:4. No same-origin requirement in prompts (not required). Restart: functional prompt uses restart_app only, no shell. Sign-in/accounts are stated in instruction.md:17 and app_context.md (also a known FP per skill/internal annotation). Counterexample search: a conforming app using process.cwd()-relative static paths, reading /assets at runtime, binding 'localhost', needing NODE_ENV, or writing durable state outside DB_PATH would fail, but each is explicitly forbidden or directed in the brief/notes, so the failure is legitimate. A weak app could pass the probe with a 500 health response (test.sh:51 accepts HTTPError) - leniency, not an unstated assumption; gate/scored judges carry the real bar. Runtime: raw-evidence-index entries (hashes re-verified: workspace.cjs 5c88d7b1..., server.log 6752f461..., workspace.json 49ff6246...; frozen server.js 4fc5d2c4... and solve.sh 1df2ed04... match) show the golden started as uid 65534 with cwd /tmp and the same five-variable env (workspace.cjs:16) and survived a real restart; server.log 'listening on 3000' twice. This is a scripted launch mirroring test.sh, not test.sh itself nor a configured judge run; this row is a source-agreement check and the agreement is fully established from source, so that gap belongs to the separate full-verifier-launch evidence requirement rather than to this row.
